snippet.title: DEMONS' NIGHT FEVER - Pre-Order Trailer
snippet.description:
ARC SYSTEM WORKS Co., Ltd. has announced that "DEMONS' NIGHT FEVER"—a team-slaying, speedrun-focused simulation RPG where the more you die, the stronger you become—will be released for PlayStation®5, Nintendo Switch™, and Steam® on Thursday, October 22, 2026.

Additionally, pre-orders for the Steam digital version as well as the physical editions for PlayStation®5 and Nintendo Switch™ have opened today.

Store Links:
Steam: https://bit.ly/DNFSteam
PlayStation: https://bit.ly/DNFPSN
Nintendo Switch: COMING SOON
